Historicism - The belief that historical events are determined by laws and trajectory, rather than randomness
Thucydides Trap - When a rising power threatens to displace a ruling power, structural stress makes violent conflict highly likely

thesis_statement: Toynbee's Challenge and Response - Civilizations rise by successfully responding to challenges and fall when their creative minorities fail
Braudel's Longue Duree - Historical time must be understood in geographical and structural long-term cycles, not just immediate events
Great Man Theory vs Social History - Historical outcomes are a dialectic between individual agency and macroscopic structural forces
